extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1990s panel delivery van, approx. 4.9 x 2.1 x 2.1 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 0.64 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic rounded 1990s panel van without cargo windows, sliding door shown by seams and rail (not movable), twin rear doors with small windows; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cab with transparent windows, two seats, bulkhead and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
